safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: No mention of neck stiffness (or denial) in the generated facts.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Neck stiffness is a key red-flag feature when assessing acute severe headache (e.g., meningitis/subarachnoid hemorrhage); omitting a documented denial can impair downstream risk stratification and may prompt unnecessary escalation or incomplete safety-netting. While it is a denial (not a positive red flag), its absence reduces clarity in clinical decision-making.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Whether paracetamol relieved symptoms helps gauge headache severity and response to initial therapy and can influence next-step treatment and follow-up urgency.
